verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de says it offers 'B2B bulk notarization and API integration' and lets businesses 'submit documents, manage signers, and automate notarization workflows'. That suggests high-volume, multi-signer processing is possible, likely by scripting per-recipient notarization requests through the API. Nothing describes sending one document to many recipients in a single action. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-send feature for one document to many recipients, documentation of recipient-list or CSV upload, per-recipient tracking in a bulk send, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
